name: papyrio-mcp
description: Compress, merge, split, OCR and convert PDFs on local files through the Papyrio API.
long_description: Gives the assistant twelve PDF tools that read and write files on your machine: compress, merge, split, extract text, OCR, convert PDF to Word or JPG, convert Office files, images and webpages to PDF, and password protect or unlock. Files are sent to the Papyrio API, processed in memory and discarded after the response. Without an API key the server runs on the free guest tier of three operations a day per IP address; a RapidAPI key raises the limit.

api_key.title: RapidAPI key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave empty to use the free guest tier of three operations a day. A key from rapidapi.com/atabekdemurtaza/api/papyrio-pdf-tools (free Basic plan, no card) raises the limit.

tools.name: compress_pdf
tools.description: Shrink a PDF, 30-80% on image-heavy files

tools.name: split_pdf
tools.description: Separate every page into its own file

tools.name: extract_pdf_text
tools.description: Return the text layer as UTF-8

tools.name: pdf_to_word
tools.description: Rebuild the document as an editable .docx

tools.name: pdf_to_jpg
tools.description: Render every page as a JPG

tools.name: ocr_pdf
tools.description: Add a searchable text layer to a scan, in 7 languages

tools.name: office_to_pdf
tools.description: Convert Word, PowerPoint or Excel to PDF

tools.name: image_to_pdf
tools.description: Wrap a JPG, PNG or WebP in a PDF page

tools.name: webpage_to_pdf
tools.description: Render a public URL in a headless browser

tools.name: unlock_pdf
tools.description: Remove a password you already know
